packetName: Mark 5 TMI Content Model and Proof Registry
purpose: Defines a reusable local content model (Part A), a proof registry designed to prevent unverified marketing claims from entering the hub (Part B), and a content-production backlog translating the Mark 3 content-fuel plan into prioritized, non-promotional work items (Part E). Documentation, content-model, and test-planning only -- no conversion feature, CMS, form, or third-party integration is introduced.

partA_contentModel.note: Every object type below is a LOCAL, TYPED DATA SHAPE ONLY -- no content-collection directory, CMS, or publication workflow exists in the repository yet. None of these object types has been instantiated with real content in this pass beyond what already exists (e.g. the /about page's reuse of ORG.boilerplate). Introducing an actual src/content/ collection is left to a future pass once the owner confirms this model, per the instruction not to build a CMS unless it is already dependency-free and introduces no new public claims.

partB_proofRegistry.note: Every entry below is a TEMPLATE ROW ONLY. No customer name, result, metric, social statistic, product fact, health claim, or founder credential was invented to populate it -- every 'exactProposedWording' field is either blank or an explicit placeholder, and every 'verificationStatus' is 'absent' because no local evidence exists yet for any of these categories. This registry exists to give the owner a structured place to supply evidence into, mirroring the pattern already proven in alexandermathai.com's claims.registry.json.

entries.claimOrProposedProofType: Case-study reference (a named or anonymized past engagement)
entries.exactProposedWording: [TEMPLATE -- no wording proposed; blank until a real, permission-confirmed engagement exists]
entries.requiredQualifiers: Must name only what the client has explicitly approved; must not imply a typical or guaranteed result
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: Must not appear on any route, in any format, until verificationStatus reaches 'approved for bounded use'

entries.claimOrProposedProofType: Engagement volume/count claim (e.g. number of clients or projects)
entries.requiredQualifiers: Must be independently countable/auditable, not a rounded or estimated figure
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: No count of any kind may appear before approval

entries.claimOrProposedProofType: This ecosystem's own rebuild (texasmovement.com + alexandermathai.com) used as a self-referential case example
entries.exactProposedWording: [TEMPLATE -- blank; per docs/mark-3-ecosystem-build-blueprint.md, not usable as a case study until both hubs independently reach a release-candidate/Live status]
entries.evidenceSourceType: This repository's own build/release-control evidence (Mark 2.1 gate matrix)
entries.requiredQualifiers: May not be used until both hubs' G0-G8 gates independently clear
entries.expirationRevalidationDate: Recheck whenever the Mark 2.1 gate matrix is updated
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: No reference to this build as a proven case example anywhere public

entries.claimOrProposedProofType: Aggregate view-count figure (the previously flagged '2.1M+ views' figure)
entries.exactProposedWording: [TEMPLATE -- blank; the figure is founder-reported and has never been independently verified from any session]
entries.requiredQualifiers: Must cite the exact platform, date range, and export method; must not be rounded up
entries.expirationRevalidationDate: Revalidate at each reporting interval once approved (recommended quarterly)
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: Must never be presented as confirmed anywhere, including social captions or a media kit

entries.evidenceSourceType: Manual, human confirmation that the account is owned/operated by TMI
entries.requiredQualifiers: A human must manually open the URL and confirm ownership before it is used anywhere
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: No account URL may be linked or referenced before manual confirmation

entries.evidenceSourceType: Documented, non-clinical methodology plus DISCLAIMERS.performance applied verbatim
entries.requiredQualifiers: Non-clinical scope/safety review mandatory before use; must carry DISCLAIMERS.performance
entries.expirationRevalidationDate: Revisit if methodology or safety standards change
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: No diagnosis, treatment, injury-prevention, or guaranteed-outcome language before approval, and none ever regardless of approval status

entries.requiredQualifiers: Must name the issuing body and be independently verifiable
entries.expirationRevalidationDate: Revalidate at the credential's own renewal date

entries.claimOrProposedProofType: Any product, catalog, pricing, checkout, fulfillment, or support statement
entries.exactProposedWording: [TEMPLATE -- deliberately blank; per the Mark 5 brief, no such statement is allowed on this hub until a separate authenticated storefront audit and owner approval are both complete]
entries.evidenceSourceType: A full, separate, authenticated external-storefront audit
entries.evidenceLocation: Not yet supplied -- the storefront itself has not been located, reached, or audited from any session
entries.requiredQualifiers: Not applicable -- no allowed use exists yet
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: No storefront link, catalog, product claim, checkout, support claim, price, inventory, shipping, return-policy, or product-performance statement anywhere on texasmovement.com, under any circumstances, until the full audit and owner approval both complete

entries.evidenceSourceType: Named partner's explicit written permission to be referenced publicly
entries.requiredQualifiers: Written permission required per partner, per use
entries.expirationRevalidationDate: Revalidate if the partner relationship or its terms change
entries.prohibitedUseBeforeApproval: No partner name, logo, or relationship claim before permission is confirmed
